import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, T;
    static int[][] sci = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] cap = new int[15][15];
    static int[][][] maze = new int[65][15][15];
    static boolean[][][][][] reach = new boolean[15][15][65][15][15];
    static int[] head;
    static Edge[] edge;
    static int cnt;
    static int src, sink;
    static int[] level, cur;
    static final int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};

    static class Edge {
        int to, w, next;
        Edge(int to, int w, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.w = w;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edge[cnt] = new Edge(v, w, head[u]);
        head[u] = cnt++;
        edge[cnt] = new Edge(u, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = cnt++;
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        cur[s] = head[s];
        level[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edge[i].next) {
                int v = edge[i].to;
                int w = edge[i].w;
                if (level[v] != 0 || w == 0) continue;
                level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                cur[v] = head[v];
                q.add(v);
                if (v == t) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int t, int flow) {
        if (x == t) return flow;
        int rest = flow;
        for (int i = cur[x]; i != -1 && rest > 0; i = edge[i].next) {
            cur[x] = i;
            int v = edge[i].to;
            int w = edge[i].w;
            if (w > 0 && level[v] == level[x] + 1) {
                int k = dfs(v, t, Math.min(rest, w));
                if (k == 0) level[v] = 0;
                edge[i].w -= k;
                edge[i ^ 1].w += k;
                rest -= k;
            }
        }
        return flow - rest;
    }

    static int dinic(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0)
                ans += flow;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int getId(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y + k * n * n;
    }

    static void init() {
        int maxNodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        head = new int[maxNodes];
        edge = new Edge[2 * maxNodes]; // enough
        level = new int[maxNodes];
        cur = new int[maxNodes];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        cnt = 0;
        src = 2 * n * n;
        sink = src + 1;

        // propagate Z
        for (int time = 1; time <= T; ++time) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    if (maze[time - 1][x][y] != 0)
                        maze[time][x][y] = maze[time - 1][x][y];
                    else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int xx = x + dir[d][0];
                            int yy = y + dir[d][1];
                            if (xx < 1 || yy < 1 || xx > n || yy > n) continue;
                            if (maze[time - 1][xx][yy] == 2)
                                maze[time][x][y] = 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS from each scientist
        for (int sx = 1; sx <= n; ++sx) {
            for (int sy = 1; sy <= n; ++sy) {
                if (sci[sx][sy] == 0) continue;
                boolean[][][] visited = new boolean[15][15][65];
                Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                q.add(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
                visited[sx][sy][0] = true;
                reach[sx][sy][0][sx][sy] = true;
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = q.poll();
                    int cx = cur[0], cy = cur[1], step = cur[2];
                    if (step >= T) continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nx = cx + dir[d][0];
                        int ny = cy + dir[d][1];
                        if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
                        if (maze[step + 1][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                        if (visited[nx][ny][step + 1]) continue;
                        visited[nx][ny][step + 1] = true;
                        reach[sx][sy][step + 1][nx][ny] = true;
                        q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, step + 1});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // propagate reachability across time
        for (int sx = 1; sx <= n; ++sx)
            for (int sy = 1; sy <= n; ++sy)
                for (int time = 1; time <= T; ++time)
                    for (int tx = 1; tx <= n; ++tx)
                        for (int ty = 1; ty <= n; ++ty)
                            reach[sx][sy][time][tx][ty] |= reach[sx][sy][time - 1][tx][ty];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c))
                    sci[i][j] = c - '0';
                else if (c == 'Y')
                    maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z')
                    maze[0][i][j] = 2;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c))
                    cap[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        init();

        // Build graph
        int maxNodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        head = new int[maxNodes];
        edge = new Edge[2 * maxNodes * maxNodes]; // enough
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        cnt = 0;
        src = 2 * n * n;
        sink = src + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] > 0)
                    addEdge(src, getId(i, j, 0), sci[i][j]);
                if (cap[i][j] > 0)
                    addEdge(getId(i, j, 1), sink, cap[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; ++xx)
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; ++yy)
                        if (sci[x][y] > 0 && cap[xx][yy] > 0 && reach[x][y][T][xx][yy])
                            addEdge(getId(x, y, 0), getId(xx, yy, 1), INF);
        System.out.println(dinic(src, sink));
    }
}
